summary: The team coordinated the Atlas launch planning, assigning responsibilities for the customer dashboard prototype, regression testing, and API schema confirmation, and decided to use the existing PostgreSQL database with release contingent on test results.

Priya will own the dashboard prototype delivery
Alex will run regression tests after the prototype is ready
Morgan will confirm the production API response schema with the backend team
The team will use the existing PostgreSQL database
Release will occur after Alex's regression tests pass
